info.title: Agent Server
info.description: Agent server exposing models, MCP servers and skills from local YAML config.

enabled.description: Whether this server has a sandbox provider configured.

data.description: MCP `tools/list` entries, passed through verbatim from the MCP server.

url.description: Full HTTPS URL of a GitHub or GitLab repository.

path.description: Path to the skill directory within the repository. Omit to use the repository root.

name.description: Name for the skill, used as directory name in sandbox.

description.description: Concise guidance for when the agent should use the skill.

ref.description: Git ref — branch name, tag, or commit SHA.

ListSessionsOrder.description: Sort sessions by creation time. Defaults to "desc".

data.description: Data URI: `data:<mime>;base64,<payload>`. MIME type is parsed from the URI.

ListTurnEventsOrder.description: Sort events by insertion order. Defaults to "asc".

PreviousTurnIdInput.description: Defaults to 'auto' (chain to session last turn). Use 'null' for the session's first turn.

get.description: Report optional runtime capabilities available in this server deployment.
Models declared in models.yaml, reachable through the OpenAI-compatible API at the file's base_url.
MCP servers declared in mcp.yaml. Auth headers are configured via env vars and never returned.

get.summary: List tools of an MCP server
get.description: All tools exposed by the given MCP server (non-paginated), as returned by the MCP `tools/list` call. No agent-spec tool selectors are applied — this is the raw server catalog.

200.description: All tools of the MCP server.

401.description: The MCP server requires authentication (configure MCP_HEADERS / MCP_{NAME}_HEADERS).

404.description: MCP server not declared in mcp.yaml.

502.description: The MCP server could not be reached or returned an error.

post.description: Create a session holding an inline agent spec. Turns are executed against this spec.

422.description: The agent spec is valid but requires a capability this server does not provide (e.g. sandbox or skills).

get.description: List sessions (newest first by default), token-paginated. Pass `page_token` to fetch the next page, keeping the other query params constant.

parameters.description: Sort sessions by creation time. Defaults to "desc".
parameters.name: order

schema.description: Opaque token from a previous response `next_page_token`.

parameters.description: Opaque token from a previous response `next_page_token`.
parameters.name: page_token

400.description: Invalid query parameters or page token.

patch.description: Update a session's inline agent spec. An empty body is a valid no-op that refreshes `updated_at`.

422.description: The agent spec is valid but requires a capability this server does not provide (e.g. sandbox or skills).

post.summary: Cancel a running turn in a session
post.description: Cancel the running last turn for a session.

412.description: Requested action cannot be performed on the session because it is no longer usable, or the executor owning the running turn is unreachable.

get.description: List session events as `{ turn_id, event }` across the active turn branch (newest first), including persisted events from a running tip. Each turn contributes turn.created, content events (model.message, tool.call, …), and turn.done when terminal; streaming deltas are not included. Use `page_token` to paginate backward toward older events while retaining the original branch anchor.

schema.description: Pagination cursor from `pagination.next_page_token`. It retains the branch anchor turn and returns older events toward the session start.

parameters.description: Pagination cursor from `pagination.next_page_token`. It retains the branch anchor turn and returns older events toward the session start.
parameters.name: page_token

schema.description: Newest turn in the listing window (initial load only; ignored when `page_token` is set). Lists that turn and its ancestors, newest events first. Omit to use the session last turn.

parameters.description: Newest turn in the listing window (initial load only; ignored when `page_token` is set). Lists that turn and its ancestors, newest events first. Omit to use the session last turn.
parameters.name: last_turn_id

schema.description: Max events per response. Default 100, max 100.

parameters.description: Max events per response. Default 100, max 100.
parameters.name: limit

get.description: List turns for a session (newest first by default), token-paginated.

post.summary: Create and execute a turn in a session
post.description:
Create a turn within a session and stream its execution as Server-Sent Events.
Use `previous_turn_id` to chain to the session's last turn (defaults to `auto`).

200.description: Server-Sent Events stream of turn events.

404.description: Session or prior turn not found.

412.description: Requested action cannot be performed on the session because it is no longer usable.
